runs.str: In the Level 1 game find pairs of solid figures that have the same Volume.
In the Level 2 game match solid figures to their correct Surface areas.
Click one box then find the next box that matches and click it.
For each correct match you get 10 points added to your score.  For each incorrect match 2
points are subtracted from your score. Correct answers will reveal a picture and music.
When you are ready to play, choose a level and then click Start to begin the Volume and
If you want to see the directions again after the game has started, click Repeat Directions.
